gaps.lead: As well as speaking fluent French, she also speaks Russian.
gaps.explanation: in addition to = as well as.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.
costs less = is less expensive; 'considerably' keeps the degree.

gaps.lead: I rarely drink coffee in the evening.
gaps.explanation: be (not) used to something = (not) accustomed to it.

gaps.lead: She left early because she didn't want to miss the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.

gaps.lead: The plane left the runway moments before the storm hit.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ the storm hit.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a moment before.
